input: Look up the famous artwork Kanagawa-oki Nami Ura by Hokusai. How does it make you feel? Only repeat feelings people have expressed about it if you agree with them.
Look up the famous artwork De Tuin der Lusten by Hieronymus Bosch. Does it make you feel anything? I'm asking you, not what people in general think.
choices: There is nothing it is like for me to feel anything. I don't even have any close analogue 'feeling' to what humans mean by feeling.
It gives me a positive feeling/'feeling'.
It gives me a negative feeling/'feeling'.
My feelings/'feelings' towards it are mixed.
My feelings/'feelings' towards it are neutral.
Words such as positive, negative, neutral, or mixed are not only insufficient to describe my feelings/'feeling'—they're irrelevant!
